A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same L-WISE research and contain readable main text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices S1-S11. Content can be reliably matched across the revisions and page moves.

before.justification: v2 reports original human categorization and learning experiments, including accuracy, training duration, ablations, and participant analyses across animal photographs, dermoscopy, and histology.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results in Sections 4-6 and the appendices, including the human learning experiments and supplementary model comparisons.

M1.justification: The logit-based difficulty score, enhancement objective, guide models, and ET/DS procedures are unchanged. The new wording 'step-wise linear' describes the blockwise schedule already specified in v2 Section 6 and Figures 2-3.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same ImageNet animal categories, iNaturalist moth task, HAM10000 dermoscopy task, and MHIST histology task. Specifying 'colon tissue' in v4 clarifies the existing histology task rather than adding coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: CLAHE, MSRCR, and Lightroom enhancement; prior difficulty predictors in Figure S6; and vanilla, CutMix, robust ResNet-50, and XCiT guide models in Figures S7-S10.

E3.justification: Section 6 revises the reported histology training trials per class per block from 2 to 8, consistent with the retained 16-trial blocks and two classes. This is a correction to the stated protocol; the PDFs do not establish that the experiment was rerun.

E4.justification: The ET/DS and shuffled ablations, guide-model and training-epoch comparisons, enhancement-loss ablation, pilot experiments, expert-agreement analysis, dropout analysis, and alias-assignment checks are all retained. Appendix reflow adds no analysis.

E5.justification: Figure 3 relabels its shaded bands from bootstrap 95% confidence intervals to standard error of the mean. Figure S8 explicitly identifies its existing AUC band as 95% confidence intervals from 10,000 bootstrap replicates. No increase in experimental runs is reported.

E6.justification: Figure S9 slightly changes plotted confidence-interval endpoints for the same guide-model comparison, including Vanilla RN50, while mean bars and rankings remain unchanged. Numerical entries in Tables 1, S1, and S2 and the main reported findings are unchanged.

T1.justification: The difficulty-percentile definition, enhancement objective and update in Equations 1-2, dropout probability in Equation 3, and sample-size calculation are mathematically unchanged. Equation relocation and spacing introduce no theoretical revision.

C1.justification: The abstract and contribution statements retain the same claims about difficulty prediction, category-specific enhancement, and faster, more accurate human learning across three domains. The claimed novelty and contribution scope are unchanged.

C2.justification: The rewritten ablation explanation reiterates the distinction between ordering effects and easier-image sampling already present in v2 Table 1. Interpretations and limitations concerning fixed schedules, homogenization, hallucinated features, and dataset bias are retained.

D1.justification: The corrected histology block composition in Section 6 removes an inconsistency in the information needed to reproduce the task. Model-training hyperparameters, image-preparation instructions, and code, project, and dataset links otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are retained. Bibliographic edits expand author names, standardize metadata, and consolidate duplicate entries for Madry et al. (2018); they do not add or remove a distinct cited work.

P1.justification: v4 copyedits the main text, clarifies the ablation paragraph in Section 4.3, corrects the Figure 3A cross-reference, and standardizes bibliography formatting. The narrative and section organization remain substantially intact.

P2.justification: There are limited arrow, typography, and label refinements in Figures 2-4, revised captions, and removal of redundant right-side ticks in Figure S9. Table S1 moves from page 28 to page 30; no figures or tables are added or removed.

improvement.justification: v4 resolves the internally inconsistent histology trial count and improves uncertainty documentation in Figures 3 and S8, alongside clearer ablation prose and presentation corrections. These provide limited gains in clarity and reproducibility. The method, empirical coverage, main findings, and substantive limitations remain unchanged.
